name: Employee Autoname RUMBA (Before Insert)
script:
join = doc.date_of_joining
if not join or not doc.kategori_karyawan:
    frappe.throw("date_of_joining dan kategori_karyawan wajib diisi sebelum simpan.")
s = str(join)
yy = s[2:4]
mm = s[5:7]
et = "01" if doc.kategori_karyawan in ("Tutor", "Lead Tutor") else "02"
if doc.kategori_karyawan == "Staf Pusat" or not doc.rumba_unit:
    mg = "01"
else:
    k = frappe.db.get_value("Rumba Unit", doc.rumba_unit, "kepemilikan")
    mg = {"YRKI": "01", "Franchise": "02", "Partnership": "03"}.get(k, "01")
prefix = yy + mm + et + mg
rows = frappe.db.get_list("Employee", filters={"name": ["like", prefix + "%"]}, fields=["name"], order_by="name desc", limit=1, ignore_permissions=True)
if rows:
    last = rows[0]["name"][len(prefix):]
    nxt = int(last) + 1
else:
    nxt = 1
doc.name = prefix + str(nxt).zfill(2)

name: Generate Kode Unit
script:
# DocType Event: Before Insert (atau Before Save)

if not doc.kode_unit:
    kode_provinsi = (doc.kode_provinsi or "").strip().upper()
    if not kode_provinsi:
        frappe.throw("Field Kode Provinsi wajib diisi sebelum membuat Kode Unit.")

    last_row = frappe.db.sql(
        """
        SELECT kode_unit
        FROM `tabRumba Unit`
        WHERE kode_unit LIKE %s
        ORDER BY CAST(RIGHT(kode_unit, 2) AS UNSIGNED) DESC
        LIMIT 1
        """,
        (f"{kode_provinsi}%",),
        as_dict=True,
    )

    next_no = 1
    if last_row and last_row[0].kode_unit:
        suffix = (last_row[0].kode_unit or "")[-2:]
        if suffix.isdigit():
            next_no = int(suffix) + 1

    if next_no > 99:
        frappe.throw(f"Kode Unit untuk provinsi {kode_provinsi} sudah mencapai batas {kode_provinsi}99.")

    doc.kode_unit = f"{kode_provinsi}{next_no:02d}"

Generate Nama Semester
Pilih Kota dan Unit
script:
kota_input = frappe.form_dict.get("kode_kota")

kode_kota = kota_input

if kota_input:
	kota_match = frappe.get_all(
		"Rumba Kota",
		filters={},
		or_filters=[
			["Rumba Kota", "name", "=", kota_input],
			["Rumba Kota", "kode_kota", "=", kota_input],
			["Rumba Kota", "nama_kota", "=", kota_input],
		],
		fields=["name", "kode_kota", "nama_kota"],
		limit_page_length=1,
		ignore_permissions=True
	)

	if kota_match:
		kode_kota = kota_match[0].name

frappe.response["message"] = frappe.get_all(
	"Rumba Unit",
	filters={
		"kode_kota": kode_kota,
		"status_unit": ["!=", "Tutup"]
	},
	fields=["name", "nama_unit", "kode_unit", "email_unit", "kode_kota", "status_unit"],
	order_by="nama_unit asc",
	limit_page_length=100,
	ignore_permissions=True
)

name: Format Nomor Pendaftaran
script:
# Server Script: DocType Event
# Reference: Rumba Pendaftaran
# Event: Before Insert

is_new_doc = doc.is_new() or not doc.get("name") or str(doc.name).startswith("new-")

if is_new_doc:
    kode_cabang = (doc.get("kode_unit") or "").strip().upper()

    if not kode_cabang and doc.get("nama_unit"):
        kode_cabang = (frappe.db.get_value("Rumba Unit", doc.nama_unit, "kode_unit") or "").strip().upper()

    if not kode_cabang:
        frappe.throw("Kode cabang tidak ditemukan. Pilih Unit yang memiliki kode_unit sebelum menyimpan.")

    allowed = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-"
    for ch in kode_cabang:
        if ch not in allowed:
            frappe.throw("Kode cabang hanya boleh berisi huruf kapital, angka, atau tanda '-'.")

    dt = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.get("tanggal_pendaftaran") or frappe.utils.today())
    yymm = dt.strftime("%y%m")
    prefix = "REG-{0}-{1}-".format(kode_cabang, yymm)

    last = frappe.db.sql(
        """
        SELECT name
        FROM `tabRumba Pendaftaran`
        WHERE name LIKE %s
        ORDER BY name DESC
        LIMIT 1
        """,
        (prefix + "%",),
        as_list=1,
    )

    if last and last[0][0]:
        try:
            last_seq = int(last[0][0].split("-")[-1])
        except Exception:
            last_seq = 0
    else:
        last_seq = 0

    doc.name = "{0}{1:04d}".format(prefix, last_seq + 1)
